name: Open Path in File Explorer
description: Opens a folder or file in Windows File Explorer. Use this when the user asks to open a folder or browse to a path.

params.name: path
params.description: The folder or file path to open in Explorer

name: Get Active Application Windows
description: Lists all currently open application windows with their names and titles.
command_template: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.MainWindowTitle -ne ''} | Select-Object Name, MainWindowTitle | Format-Table -AutoSize"

name: Set System Volume
description: Sets the Windows system volume level (0-100).
command_template: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$wshShell = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; $vol = [math]::Round({level} / 100 * 65535); (New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).NameSpace(0x0).Self.Path | Out-Null; [System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ReleaseComObject($wshShell) | Out-Null; nircmd.exe setsysvolume $vol 2>$null; Write-Host 'Volume set to {level}%'"
